rows.story_lead: Jill's animals have to move out of her bedroom before the new baby arrives, so she starts her own farm in the yard, even though everything in her wants it to stay the same. The barn, it turns out, is already occupied by a bossy duckling.
rows.resolution: The worry of everything changing gets talked through with Jamma, and saying the change she dreads out loud is how Jill carries the new-baby news.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (Forever Dreaming transcript, content verified against catalog: animals out of Jill's room, Quackety the bossy duckling in the barn, Jamma talk)'; confidence high. No controlled topic fits a farm-start story; left empty by design. Content consideration carried: new-baby arrival setup.

rows.story_lead: The new baby brother arrives, and both sisters want to be first to hold him, except nobody can cuddle him yet. Jacky learns to wait by egg-sitting the golden egg the way Mum cares for the baby.
rows.resolution: The impatience of waiting your turn settles into patience, coached explicitly by Mum, and the first huggle is what the waiting was for.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set note reads 'Script tier (Gestdown SRT, content verified against catalog: big sisters, first huggle, Jacky egg-sitting like Mum with the baby)'; confidence high. Coping anchor per dev set: Mummy coaches patience explicitly.

rows.story_lead: Jacky wants to name her new baby brother, but Squashy, Sleepy and Softy all get turned down, and it starts to feel like nobody will listen. The sisters build the name Joshy together instead.
rows.resolution: The frustration of being unheard gets talked out with Jamma listening, and two big sisters making magic together is how Joshy gets his name.

rows.story_lead: In the storm, Jill tries to rescue her lost sheep and herd her goats single-handedly, and refuses every offer of help until the boots and the bike are stuck too. Taking Jamma's hand is what works.
